ĕpī^trĭtos , a, um, adj., = ἐπίτριτος,
I. containing four thirds.
I. In gen. (pure Lat. sesquitertius), in the relation of four to three, Gell. 18, 14, 5; Macr. Somn. Scip. 2, 1, § 15 al.; cf. as fin.—
